meanings.tr: hava, atmosfer (bir kişi veya yerin verdiği izlenim)
meanings.en: a distinctive quality or feeling that seems to surround a person or place
meanings.exampleEn: She has an aura of calm confidence about her.
meanings.exampleTr: Onda sakin bir özgüven havası var.

meanings.en: a person who fights in a war or conflict
meanings.exampleEn: Both combatants were exhausted after the long battle.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun savaştan sonra iki savaşçı da tükenmişti.

meanings.en: (of a disease) able to be passed from one person to another
meanings.exampleEn: Measles is a highly communicable disease.
meanings.exampleTr: Kızamık son derece bulaşıcı bir hastalıktır.

meanings.tr: müdahale etmeme, karışmama (özellikle başka bir devletin işlerine)
meanings.en: the policy of not becoming involved in the affairs of others, especially other countries
meanings.exampleEn: The government maintained a strict policy of nonintervention in the conflict.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet çatışmaya müdahale etmeme konusunda katı bir politika izledi.

meanings.en: having or showing a feeling of vague or regretful longing
meanings.exampleEn: She gave a wistful smile as she looked at the old photographs.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski fotoğraflara bakarken hüzünlü bir gülümseme verdi.

meanings.en: the state of not being legally or logically valid
meanings.exampleEn: The court ruled on the invalidity of the contract.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme sözleşmenin geçersizliğine karar verdi.

meanings.en: close-fitting garments that cover the foot and part of the leg, usually worn by women
meanings.exampleEn: She wore silk stockings with her evening dress.
meanings.exampleTr: Gece elbisesiyle birlikte ipek çoraplar giydi.

meanings.en: a person who disagrees with an official or majority opinion
meanings.exampleEn: The lone dissenter voted against the proposal.
meanings.exampleTr: Tek muhalif teklife karşı oy kullandı.

meanings.en: the state of not existing; the absence of anything
meanings.exampleEn: He stared into the empty nothingness of space.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzayın boş hiçliğine baktı.

meanings.en: lacking sophistication or good taste; offensively rude
meanings.exampleEn: He told a vulgar joke that embarrassed everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkesi utandıran kaba bir şaka anlattı.

meanings.en: crude and offensive in a sexual way
meanings.exampleEn: He was arrested for making lewd remarks in public.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplum içinde müstehcen sözler söylediği için tutuklandı.

meanings.en: no longer fashionable or useful; out of date
meanings.exampleEn: The factory still relies on outmoded machinery.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika hâlâ modası geçmiş makinelere güveniyor.

meanings.en: extremely distasteful; unacceptable
meanings.exampleEn: The idea of cheating was repugnant to her.
meanings.exampleTr: Hile yapma fikri ona iğrenç geliyordu.

meanings.en: young human beings below the age of puberty; the plural of child
meanings.exampleEn: The children played happily in the garden.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar bahçede mutlu mutlu oynadı.

meanings.en: a person's or animal's offspring or descendants
meanings.exampleEn: The champion racehorse produced many successful progeny.
meanings.exampleTr: Şampiyon yarış atı birçok başarılı döl verdi.

meanings.en: existing in large quantities; abundant or generous
meanings.exampleEn: The farmers enjoyed a bountiful harvest this year.
meanings.exampleTr: Çiftçiler bu yıl bereketli bir hasadın tadını çıkardı.

meanings.en: willingness to consider or accept new ideas or suggestions
meanings.exampleEn: Her receptiveness to feedback made her a great student.
meanings.exampleTr: Geri bildirime açık olması onu harika bir öğrenci yaptı.

meanings.en: the quality of being very unusual or remarkable
meanings.exampleEn: The extraordinariness of the discovery amazed scientists worldwide.
meanings.exampleTr: Keşfin olağanüstülüğü dünya çapında bilim insanlarını hayrete düşürdü.

meanings.en: the arrangement of things in a straight line or in correct relative positions; agreement or support
meanings.exampleEn: We need better alignment between the sales and marketing teams.
meanings.exampleTr: Satış ve pazarlama ekipleri arasında daha iyi bir uyuma ihtiyacımız var.

meanings.en: a person who establishes an institution, company, or organization
meanings.exampleEn: She is the founder of a successful tech startup.
meanings.exampleTr: O, başarılı bir teknoloji girişiminin kurucusudur.

meanings.en: (of a ship) to fill with water and sink; (of a plan) to fail
meanings.exampleEn: The ship began to founder in the storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Gemi fırtınada batmaya başladı.

meanings.tr: sapkınlık, kabul görmüş inançlara aykırı görüş
meanings.en: a belief or opinion that goes against orthodox or accepted doctrine
meanings.exampleEn: His ideas were once condemned as heresy by the church.
meanings.exampleTr: Fikirleri bir zamanlar kilise tarafından sapkınlık olarak kınandı.

meanings.en: the quality of not conforming to accepted or traditional beliefs and practices
meanings.exampleEn: His unorthodoxy in business made competitors nervous.
meanings.exampleTr: İş dünyasındaki aykırılığı rakiplerini tedirgin etti.

meanings.en: not organized to work together well; clumsy in movement
meanings.exampleEn: The rescue effort was chaotic and uncoordinated.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurtarma çabası karmakarışık ve koordinasyonsuzdu.

meanings.tr: üst geçit (İngiliz İngilizcesi); alçak uçuş geçişi (Amerikan İngilizcesi)
meanings.en: a bridge that carries one road over another; a low ceremonial flight of aircraft
meanings.exampleEn: Traffic was diverted onto the flyover to avoid the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazadan kaçınmak için trafik üst geçide yönlendirildi.

meanings.en: easily upset by criticism or insults
meanings.exampleEn: He is too thin-skinned to work in such a competitive industry.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kadar rekabetçi bir sektörde çalışamayacak kadar alıngan.

meanings.en: to show or demonstrate something clearly through actions or signs
meanings.exampleEn: The disease can manifest itself in many different ways.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalık kendini birçok farklı şekilde gösterebilir.

meanings.en: clear and obvious to the eye or mind
meanings.exampleEn: His anger was manifest to everyone in the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Öfkesi odadaki herkes için aşikârdı.

meanings.en: not openly acknowledged or displayed; secret
meanings.exampleEn: The agency ran a covert operation to gather intelligence.
meanings.exampleTr: Ajans istihbarat toplamak için gizli bir operasyon yürüttü.

meanings.en: an exclamation expressing sudden pain
meanings.exampleEn: Ouch! That really hurt.
meanings.exampleTr: Ah! Bu gerçekten canımı yaktı.

meanings.en: an informal word for mother
meanings.exampleEn: Ma, can I go out to play with my friends?
meanings.exampleTr: Anne, arkadaşlarımla oynamaya çıkabilir miyim?

meanings.en: inclined to avoid conflict; peaceful in nature
meanings.exampleEn: They reached a peaceable settlement without going to court.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkemeye gitmeden barışçıl bir anlaşmaya vardılar.

meanings.en: to make someone calm or less hostile by giving in to their demands
meanings.exampleEn: The manager tried to appease the angry customers with a refund.
meanings.exampleTr: Müdür, öfkeli müşterileri para iadesiyle yatıştırmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: to make someone less angry or hostile
meanings.exampleEn: He offered an apology to placate his upset colleague.
meanings.exampleTr: Üzgün meslektaşını yatıştırmak için özür diledi.

meanings.tr: al al olma, kırmızılık (yüz için sağlıklı kırmızılık)
meanings.en: a healthy reddish color, especially of the face
meanings.exampleEn: The ruddiness of his cheeks showed he had been outdoors all day.
meanings.exampleTr: Yanaklarının kırmızılığı bütün gün dışarıda olduğunu gösteriyordu.

meanings.en: so slight or gradual as to be impossible to notice
meanings.exampleEn: There was an almost imperceptible change in her expression.
meanings.exampleTr: İfadesinde neredeyse fark edilemez bir değişiklik oldu.

meanings.en: a large open area of land covered mainly with grass
meanings.exampleEn: Herds of zebra grazed across the open grassland.
meanings.exampleTr: Zebra sürüleri açık çayırlarda otladı.

meanings.en: to behave as if you are superior to others; to patronize
meanings.exampleEn: Don't condescend to me as if I were a child.
meanings.exampleTr: Bana çocukmuşum gibi tepeden bakma.

meanings.en: workers employed to do manual labor on a farm
meanings.exampleEn: The farmer hired extra farmhands for the harvest season.
meanings.exampleTr: Çiftçi hasat mevsimi için ek çiftlik işçileri tuttu.

meanings.tr: çakıllı; (ses için) boğuk, kısık ve kaba
meanings.en: full of gravel; (of a voice) deep and rough-sounding
meanings.exampleEn: The singer had a distinctive gravelly voice.
meanings.exampleTr: Şarkıcının kendine özgü boğuk bir sesi vardı.

meanings.en: a peculiar behavioral habit; a strange chance occurrence
meanings.exampleEn: One of his quirks is that he always eats dessert first.
meanings.exampleTr: Tuhaflıklarından biri her zaman önce tatlı yemesidir.

meanings.en: a strange or unusual person, thing, or feature
meanings.exampleEn: The old clock was something of an oddity in the modern office.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski saat, modern ofiste biraz tuhaf bir şeydi.

meanings.tr: kişiye özgü tuhaflık, kendine has özellik
meanings.en: a distinctive or peculiar feature or characteristic of a person or thing
meanings.exampleEn: Speaking to himself was one of his many idiosyncrasies.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendi kendine konuşmak, birçok kişisel tuhaflığından biriydi.

meanings.en: so good that nothing else can be compared to it
meanings.exampleEn: She played the piano with matchless skill.
meanings.exampleTr: Piyanoyu eşsiz bir ustalıkla çaldı.

meanings.en: better or greater than any other; without equal
meanings.exampleEn: Her contribution to the field remains unequalled.
meanings.exampleTr: Alana katkısı hâlâ emsalsizdir.
